verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say it takes Linear/Jira tickets and implements features or bug fixes in its own cloud VM with full repo access. With Auto-Fix it responds to review comments and iterates on CI failures until PRs are merge-ready, closing the loop from ticket to PR. Hands-on reports temper this: one user saw extraneous changes beyond the task that broke other things, and another only got real work done by checking in every 10-15 minutes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the ticket-to-PR opening step (issue linking, PR creation mechanics), and independent corroboration of reliable unattended end-to-end completion without scope creep.
